# Wooolfmesh

Wooolfmesh is a local-first work environment built around calm, persistent Studios rather than dashboards. A Studio keeps the current task or artifact, useful memory, sources, AI assistance, and execution state in one bounded work context.

The product is being simplified. More intelligence underneath should usually produce less interface on screen. Memory, local search, task state, ML ranking, agent runs, Obsidian context, and optional AI providers can become smarter without creating more permanent panels.

Wooolfmesh is local-first, Markdown-friendly, and human-controlled. Important AI actions are previewable and recoverable. The product should remain useful when AI is unavailable.

## Current product direction

- Studios, not dashboards.
- The work artifact or task is the primary surface.
- AI, memory, sources, task state, and run history are contextual layers.
- Studio context is bounded and inspectable.
- Memory should be relevant, sourced, and quiet rather than a permanent feed.
- Proactive AI should prefer good workflow boundaries and avoid interrupting active work without a strong reason.
- Autonomy should depend on risk, reversibility, task type, and user preference.
- Finished work should be able to produce approved reusable lessons for future work.

## Research direction

Research is used to create product hypotheses, not scientific-looking marketing. Current topics include persistent work context, progressive disclosure, interruption recovery, cognitive offloading, task-shaped sources, trustworthy long-term memory, agent autonomy, proactive AI timing, human agency, and calm visual hierarchy.

The Research Radar contains newer and more experimental 2026 signals. Important current hypotheses include workflow-boundary suggestions, resume anchors, task-conditioned memory admission, source provenance, AI postures such as Think / Collaborate / Run, completion distillation, and progressive context loading.
